title: Miso — photographic asset set
provenance: All eleven images were generated specifically for a fictional cat portfolio, with one separate built-in request per asset. The hero was visually inspected and selected first, then its explicit path was included in every subsequent generation. The sleepy image was inspected before the awake edit. Original tool outputs remain at source_path, and named originals preserve their original bytes.
overall_consistency: Strong visual identity consistency: adult ginger tabby, amber eyes, pink nose, cream muzzle and small chest bib, white toe caps with ginger legs, dark orange striped rounded-tip tail. Shared studio uses sunny left window, oak desk, warm white walls, beige linen sofa, plain cardboard box and silver unbranded laptop. No costume, person, watermark, logo or fabricated screen interface.
limitations: The awake generative edit closely preserves the sleeping composition but is not mathematically pixel-identical outside the eyes; see qa.json for measured differences.
The sofa scene contains a blurred additional green plant at the lower-left foreground, a minor departure from the one-plant brief.
Laptop images contain small generated keyboard legends; there are no captions, branding, interface text or watermark.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: the identity reference and transparent cutout hero for a fictional cat portfolio.
Primary request: create ONE high quality original editorial photograph of Miso, a real-looking adult ginger tabby cat, sitting upright calmly and confidently, facing the camera. Miso has amber eyes, a pink nose, a cream muzzle, a small cream chest bib, WHITE FRONT TOES ONLY (ginger legs), and a dark orange striped tail with a rounded tip.
Composition/framing: portrait, approximately 1024x1536, centered full-body sitting cat. Entire ears, body, both front toes, hindquarters and full striped tail must fit inside the image with comfortable clear margin. The tail curves naturally next to the body. Natural adult cat proportions and anatomy.
Scene/backdrop: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha, clean individual fur edges, no backdrop, no visible floor, no fake checkerboard pattern.
Style/medium: exceptionally detailed natural photographic fur, not illustration, not CGI; warm ginger fur and bright soft daylight, balanced realistic color. Calm neutral attentive expression.
Constraints: this image will become the sole identity reference for ten more photographs. Preserve distinctive face markings, amber eyes, small cream bib and limited white toes. Four anatomically plausible legs, no human features, no costumes, no collar, no text, no watermark, no logos, no human hands. One cat only.
assets.alt: Miso, an amber-eyed ginger tabby with cream muzzle and white front toes, sitting upright with a curved striped tail.
assets.assessment: Approved identity reference. Entire ears, body, front toes and rounded striped tail visible. Genuine transparency verified: 1024x1536 RGBA; alpha extrema 0–254; 750089 fully transparent pixels.
